title: Independent mathematical and experimental review of the R75 distinct-tableau proposal
goal: Determine whether R75 merits a sealed synthetic holdout, without guessing or generating any K4 message.
constraints: No public K4 known-text material or clue-derived computations; strictly respect the previously frozen-output-first research rule.
Do not run the original K4 ciphertext, suggest complete original plaintext, select keys from any known-text check, or contact external checkers.
Independent mathematical evidence outranks multi-model agreement. No solver mutation, ledger change or PR merge.
Use only the curated information below or the specifically listed r75 reference source files in a sandbox with no other repository or internet access.
Distinguish independent code check from a reported prior test; do not claim a live multi-model debate unless distinct models really executed.

facts.claim: R75 specifies two successive same-alphabet Quagmire-like substitutions with different AZ/KRY alphabets, historic K1/K2 keywords in either order, independently phased and signed, no transposition.
There are 2880 distinct map sequences at period 40; this was enumerated by a draft mathematical audit, but not proven to be globally novel against all previous arbitrary-alphabet methods.
facts.source: r75/audit.py and r75/AUDIT_LOCAL.json in draft PR 67

facts.claim: A local technical-prose smoke reported 60/60 exact held-out known-family plaintext-and-setting recovery and 0/120 false-confident negatives; it has not been independently reproduced or sealed on literary sources.
There is no independent demonstrated historical signal that Sanborn switched tableaux between the two stages. The period-40 signature is weak at 97 characters.
facts.source: r75/reference.py and independent analysis of that implementation

facts.claim: The multi-model independent-draft and adversarial-review design comes from an MIT-licensed Copilot CLI plugin; this implementation reuses the method, not its source code.

questions: Is every modeled 40-position permutation genuinely new relative to the scoped earlier L03, L21, L36 and R74 families? Identify exact coverage gaps and an executable equivalence test.
Can a reviewer construct a distinctive ciphertext-only diagnostic with calibrated unknown-family power, before any use of actual K4?
What alternative cipher families and source-disjoint literary holdouts should compete against R75, and what false-positive cutoff would justify proceeding?
Is a synthetic model-only 60/60 result informative about method discovery when 97-character messages could come from arbitrary other cipher families?
Should we approve sealed controls, keep this as low-priority coverage testing, or stop entirely? Justify with expected information gain.
